test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which app was announced in June 2025 to identify sporting talent via videos?
solution:
The correct answer is __**TOPS Talent App**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **TOPS Talent App** was announced in **June 2025** by the Government of India to identify and nurture **sporting talent** across the country through user-uploaded videos.
 
• This initiative is a part of the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)**, which aims to provide support to athletes with potential to win medals at the **Olympic Games**.
 
• The app leverages **technology and artificial intelligence** to analyze videos submitted by athletes, enabling the identification of raw and untapped talent from **remote and rural areas**.
 
• It is designed to ensure a more **inclusive and transparent talent selection process**, reducing biases and ensuring equal opportunities for all participants.
 
• The app is supported by the **Sports Authority of India (SAI)**, which plays a critical role in evaluating the submissions and facilitating further training for selected athletes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS):**

 
 
• The **TOPS** initiative was launched in **2014** by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to enhance India’s performance at the **Olympics** and other international sporting events.
 
• It focuses on providing **financial assistance, training support, and world-class facilities** to elite athletes.
 
• The scheme has successfully supported several medal-winning athletes in events like the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**.
 
 
 
• **Sports Authority of India (SAI):**
 
 
• SAI is a **government body** established in **1984** under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• It is responsible for the promotion of **sports and development of athletes** through initiatives like **Khelo India** and the **National Sports Development Fund**.
 
• SAI also manages various **national sports academies and centers** for excellence.
 
 
 
• **Features of the TOPS Talent App:**
 
 
• Enables athletes to **upload videos** showcasing their skills directly from their smartphones.
 
• Uses **AI-driven analytics** to evaluate performance metrics like speed, strength, and technique.
 
• Ensures participation from athletes across **all age groups** and geographical locations, including **rural and underserved areas**.
 
• Provides a platform for connecting with **coaches, scouts, and talent evaluators**.
 
 
 
• **Other Initiatives for Sports Talent Identification:**
 
 
• **Khelo India Programme:** A flagship initiative launched in **2018** to promote grassroots sports and identify young talent.
 
• **SAI Schemes:** Various schemes under SAI focus on providing **training, scholarships, and infrastructure** for budding athletes.
 
• **National Sports Talent Search Portal:** An online portal launched in **2017** to scout and nurture young talent.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **TOPS Talent App** is a significant move toward leveraging **digital technology** for sports development in India.
 
• It complements existing initiatives like **Khelo India** by focusing on **Olympic-level athletes** and providing them with targeted support.
 
• The app encourages greater participation from **marginalized communities**, promoting **inclusivity** in the field of sports.
 
• By using AI and data-driven insights, the app ensures a **scientific approach** to talent selection and development.
